We are outsourcing what makes us human, our attention, emotions, judgment, and habits, without noticing. This talk uses a cybersecurity lens to show how AI quietly compromises the human operating system through small, almost invisible increments, and offers a simple framework to take it back.
 Eva Benn is a Principal Security Program Manager at Microsoft. Eva has spent more of her security in ethical hacking and penetration testing, both as a people leader and hands-on practitioner. She is a globally recognized security leader, holding an extensive list of industry certifications.

In this talk, Samantha Ko shares her journey of rediscovering love, courage, and authenticity by embracing life’s uncertainties and letting go of perfection. She invites you to give yourself permission to be seen, flawed, and fully alive. Samantha Ko, an actress from Hong Kong, China, is well-known for her on-screen characters that embody both sexiness and depth. Since entering the industry as Miss Hong Kong in 2008, she has cultivated her capability of acting through years of supporting roles, accumulating power in dramas such as Line Walker and Barrack o’karma.
In 2023, she ushered in a highlight moment in the annual topical drama series The Queen of News, where she accurately portrayed the role of the ambitious anchor Xu Shiqing, showcasing the character's sharpness and vulnerability, desires and loneliness with great intensity. She won the "Best Supporting Actress" award at TVB Awards Presentation 2023.
Her journey

From a law professional to a host, Zhang Yaqi shares her inspiring personal journey and reveals the core to seizing destiny: dare to leap forward amid confusion, gather strength through perseverance, and take bold action when opportunity knocks. author: TEDx Talks
description:
"Growth isn't the absence of mistakes; it's the presence of depth."
Geonho Kim, a visually impaired high school pianist, has played J.S. Bach's Italian Concerto for years. While he once focused only on the effort of memorizing notes, a memory slip during a 2021 concert changed his entire perspective on music. In this performance-lecture, he shares how an unexpected mistake on stage became his greatest teacher.

He began to hear the "lines within lines" that he had previously overlooked by returning to the basics and asking "why." Through both his story and a live performance of the concerto's second and third movements, he explains how this piece forced him to grow and finally find his own "Personal Tchaikovsky." Geonho Kim is a first-year student at Seoul Arts High School. Selected as a Kumho Young Artist in 2022, he has already performed on international stages. 
As a musician who studies his craft through Braille scores, he shows us the true power of dedication. This talk was given
title: My Personal Tchaikovsky | Geonho Kim | TEDxChadwick International School

author: TEDx Talks
description:
「生的再奇怪，我們都是限量版。」

比起在意外界質疑的聲音，謝嘉宸更專注於發掘自我特質與價值。在追求認同的過程中，最大的挑戰往往來自自己。每一個在別人眼中的「不完美」，其實都能成為獨一無二的亮點。她相信，這世界從來不缺乏「美」，而是缺少「發現」。

你呢？發現自己了嗎？ 謝嘉宸（Miya），具有中山醫學大學護理系背景，現為演員、模特兒、主持人、運動員及 KOL。作為一名性別還原者，她選擇以自信與真誠活出自己，展現出跨越束縛後的光亮與勇氣。
Miya 最初從外拍模特兒嶄露頭角，逐步累積粉絲關注，並跨足影視領域。近年主演電影《關山渡若飛》，於台北電影節首映，展現她在戲劇表演上的突破與潛能。自性別重置手術至今已超過十年，她將外界的質疑化為力量，挑戰傳統框架，甚至真誠詮釋母親角色，持續打破對跨性別者的偏見。
除了演藝與時尚，她也是熱愛排球的運動員，以專業標準要求自己，透過自律與努力挑戰「身形優勢」的迷思。如今，她不僅在娛樂、運動與社群領域持續發光，也積極倡議性別多元，強調「性別是流動的」，用真實故事鼓勵更多人勇敢做自己。 This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: 跨越框架：在舞台、賽場與人生中，以真實綻放 | 嘉宸 謝 | TEDxNTHU

author: TEDx Talks
description:
關於那些生命低谷，賴雷娜曾陷入黑暗和憂鬱，但她認為，這並不代表沒救了，而是學會與它共處，放下治好它的執著。

關於那些脆弱迷惘，積累成許多內心創傷，但這不能成為賴雷娜自暴自棄的理由，而是學會求助並勇敢創造連結。

縱使路上佈滿荊棘，但帶著脆弱一步步前行，賴雷娜相信「即便在一無所有之中，也能找到屬於自己的光，看到那個『夠好的自己』」。
 I-LIFE 創辦人。
2010 年啟動「夢想騎士計劃」，首創結合體驗教育、心理輔導與戶外冒險治療的「零元旅行」，帶領青年跨越舒適圈，在出走中修復傷口、看見自身力量。
2015 年成立 I-LIFE，專注陪伴 18 至 30 歲的「半熟大人」走過低潮和迷惘，至今已服務超過 600 位青年重建自信與勇氣，找到自身存在的意義。
一路走來，積累了家族治療與社工領域的實務經驗，堅信療癒不只存在於輔導室，而是在一次次的行動與體驗裡。
目前是兩個孩子的媽，也持續在生活中出走，鼓勵青年勇於信任並連結、創造正向的互動，成為彼此生命裡的美好祝福。 This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: 在一無所有之中 看見夠好的自己 | 雷娜 賴 | TEDxNTHU

author: TEDx Talks
description:
在社會對成功的既定想像之外，廖健妤選擇走上一條沒有人教過的路，用設計開創另一種對「老」的想像。這場分享從廖健妤爸媽的退休生活談起——原以為退休是享福的開始，卻發現他們卸下角色後失去了生活重心。這讓她開始思考：難道熟齡人生只能如此？

廖健妤因此創立了「老玩客」，希望可以陪伴長者找回自我價值，重新建立與社會的連結。在這段旅程中，她遇過挫折、也看見轉變。廖健妤將分享創業歷程、與長輩互動的故事，怎麼把「自由」視為最重要的財富。
 廖健妤，國立清華大學科技管理學院學士班與服務科學研究所畢業，為社會企業「老玩客」創辦人。從普通的上班族轉向自主創業之路，在人生選擇上，她長期思索如何在缺乏標準答案的情況下做出屬於自己的決定，並將創業視為一種跳脫舒適圈的過程，試著重新定義自由的方式。
「老玩客」，以服務設計為基礎，專注於熟齡族群的「退休生活設計」，推動高齡就業，致力於打造友善的工作環境，讓長者不僅能再次投入社會，也能在其中發揮自身經驗與能力。其實踐涵蓋從職務設計到實體空間經營，逐步形塑對「老」的嶄新想像。
而對講者來說，真正的財富是自由，來自跳脫框架、為自己做選擇。 This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: 有選擇的人生，就是最大的財富 | 健妤 廖 | TEDxNTHU

author: TEDx Talks
description:
談及「跳脫框架」，許多人透過離開體制、轉換跑道，作為突破的證明。而在呂顥天的經驗中，框架不只是外在環境的限制，更多源自於他人眼中的標籤，甚至自己內心的懷疑。

仍身在體制內的國中小階段，呂顥天不斷以自學的方式，嘗試走出和同儕不同的路。進入實驗高中，已符合許多人對於「體制外」的定義，但呂顥天依舊選擇在課程之外另闢學習路徑。體制內外從不是絕對的二分，而是我們如何定義、如何使用。

呂顥天相信教育的價值，不在於給人標準答案，而是在於培養「製造釣竿」的能力。過程中，他也曾因年紀而遭到質疑，甚至被認為「還沒有資格」做研究，但呂顥天選擇繼續投入熱衷的領域。所謂的跳脫，不是一次性的動作，而是持續修正與累積的過程。

在本次的演講中，呂顥天希望分享的不只是自己的經歷，而是重新思考「跳脫框架」的意義：如果我們只是把框架換了一個名字，仍然困在自我設限裡，那就不是跳脫。真正的跳脫，是在面對他人的定義與社會的期待時，仍然保有選擇，並且勇敢為自己的目標找到新的路徑。對呂顥天而言，這是一場不斷摸索的過程，也是最值得堅持的理想。 呂顥天，現就讀臺北市立數位實驗高級中學，同時在 AIoT 公司擔任研發專案副理，將學術研究與實務應用相結合。自小展現高度自學精神，小學時便開始旁聽大學課程，國中投入神經科學與醫學影像研究，並多次代表台灣參與國際論壇與競賽。
2025 年榮獲「臺灣國際科展青少年科學獎」，肯定其在醫學與健康科學領域的研究潛力。除科研領域外，他亦長期關注數位人權與開放教育，於 2021 年發起「台灣開放教育推動團隊」（TOEDU），積極推廣教學資源的自由共享，並參與 g0v、COSCUP 等開源社群，致力於讓知識能更公平地流動。
曾在國中畢業典禮以全程台語致詞，展現對語言文化多樣性的關注與實踐。他自認「不想被侷限」，並持續透過跨領域的行動，探索教育、科技與社會之間的更多可能性。 This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: 重新思考「跳脫框架」 | 顥天 呂 | TEDxNTHU

People often form their first impressions of unfamiliar cities through symbolic images—such as landmarks, foods, or cultural icons—yet these representations are frequently shaped by official narratives and may differ from everyday local experience. Drawing on case studies, this talk explores how such symbols are constructed, why they sometimes feel distant to residents, and how this gap reflects broader tensions between city branding and lived reality. It argues that urban symbols are not fixed, but continuously redefined by the people who inhabit the city, with a truly vibrant city constantly generating new meanings rather than relying solely on established icons. Song Zhuangzhuang is a designer and co-founder of DIDUHUI. He holds degrees from Harvard University and Tsinghua University, and previously worked in the fields of architectural design and cultural heritage conservation.

Today, Song and his team are dedicated to the research, design and public communication of urban cultur
title: What Represents a City? | Zhuangzhuang Song | TEDxMacauUST

Can building a professional network help individuals to gain real-world experience, leading to authentic vocational discovery? In this talk, Sofia Christow-Filleul explores how hands-on clinical exposure and mentorship provide students with the clarity they need to confidently choose or reject a specific career pathway. 
 How do you know if a career is the right fit before you've committed years of your life to it? Pre-dental student and mentorship advocate Sofia Christow-Filleul doesn't think you can find out from the sidelines. Through the story of building a mentorship-driven network that gives students real, hands-on clinical exposure, she reveals why the most meaningful outcome isn't confirming a path, but having the clarity to walk away from one that was never yours. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

description:
Rajat Arora dives into why personal branding is no longer optional in today’s world - it’s essential. His talk breaks down how to create your own identity, stand out with purpose, and use consistency as the ultimate tool to build trust and long-term impact. Rajat Arora is an Indian educator, entrepreneur, and digital learning creator widely known for making commerce education accessible to millions of students through online platforms. 
Rajat Arora began his teaching journey with a strong focus on bridging the gap between traditional classroom education and the rapidly evolving digital learning environment. Recognizing that many students struggled with conventional rote-learning approaches, he adopted a teaching style centered on conceptual clarity, real-life examples, and structured explanations. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: The Power of Personal Branding | Rajat Arora | TEDxGGDSDCollege

description: Shaguna Khetarpal shares her deeply personal journey of setbacks and self-discovery, revealing how rejection became a turning point rather than an end. Her talk reflects on how life’s challenges often realign us with our true path, as if every element of the universe comes together to rebuild and redefine who we are meant to be. Shaguna khetrapal is India's First women entrepreneur pioneering 3D AR and VR . She's a founder of Zentroid Studios and Tyche Consultancy, she transforms innovation into an immersive experience . She passionately transforms, combing creativity with technology to build impactful and future proof solutions for brands. Her work lies at the intersection of 3D asset production, immersive technologies, and digital commerce, where she focuses on helping brands adopt 3D infrastructure to improve product visualization, online experiences, and interactive customer engagement. title: Rewrite your journey | Shaguna Khetarpal | TEDxGGDSDCollege

Hardik Banga explores what it truly means to be human in a world full of uncertainty. His talk dives into confronting fear, accepting the unknown, and realizing that peace and happiness come not from control - but from how we respond to life’s unpredictability. Hardik Banga is a content creator and emerging media entrepreneur with a passion for storytelling, digital culture, and building impactful online communities. 
Driven by a long-term vision, Hardik is currently working toward launching his own media company. His goal is to build a modern media brand that supports creators, produces high-quality digital content, and explores new ways of storytelling in the fast-growing creator economy. Through this venture, he hopes to collaborate with creators, brands, and communities to build content that reaches wider audiences and creates real impact. description: Nikita Gupta explores how Indian culture has quietly shaped the world in profound ways. From everyday essentials like shampoo and pankhas to deeper philosophies, her talk highlights how cultural roots influence global living. She reminds us that culture isn’t just heritage - it’s a force that continues to define the world around us. Nikita Gupta is a digital creator and founder of The Culture Gully, dedicating her platform to simplifying India’s rich culture, history, and social narratives. At Culture Gully, Nikita contributes to the development of content frameworks that explore heritage, lifestyle, art, and community-driven stories while adapting them for today’s rapidly evolving digital landscape. Her approach combines cultural research, editorial storytelling, and platform-specific content strategies to ensure that cultural narratives remain both authentic and accessible to younger, digitally native audiences. title: The Global Power of Indian Culture | Nikita Gupta | TEDxGGDSDCollege

description: Karan Gulati explores the power of self-image and how it shapes who you become. His talk goes beyond motivation, diving into the science behind belief - showing that when you truly see yourself a certain way, your actions align to make it reality. Inner work precedes hard work, and in the end, he reminds us that identity isn’t discovered, it’s decided. Karan Gulati, the face behind SikhInvestor, has built a strong voice in the world of personal finance and investing. Through his simple and practical content, he helps young people understand money without the usual jargon. His approach is honest and grounded, focusing on discipline, smart decisions, and long term thinking rather than quick gains. For many aspiring investors, he has become a trusted guide in starting their financial journey the right way. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: The Science of Self-Image | Karan Gulati | TEDxGGDSDCollege

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In a world obsessed with visibility, validation, and manufactured narratives, Vaidehi Taman did the unthinkable-she walked away.
From leading media platforms and shaping public discourse to embracing a life rooted in Dharma, her journey exposes an uncomfortable truth: what society calls success is often nothing more than well-packaged emptiness.
In this bold and unfiltered talk, she dismantles the illusion of modern achievement, questions the integrity of narratives we blindly consume, and challenges the audience to confront their own borrowed definitions of identity and purpose.
This is not a story of escape—it is a story of clarity. A call to reject noise, reclaim truth, and understand that real power begins where external validation ends. Dr. Vaidehi Taman is an acclaimed Indian journalist, editor, author, media entrepreneur, and social-spiritual thought leader with over two decades of experience shaping public discourse through fearless, insightful storytelling and ethical leaders
title: Newsrooms to Nirvana: Reclaiming Truth | Vaidehi Taman | TEDxSMShettyInternationalSchool

description: Can machines truly think—or are they only learning to imitate us? Revisiting Alan Turing’s groundbreaking question 75 years later, Rich Klein explores how today’s AI is reshaping the way we understand intelligence, creativity, and work. As artificial intelligence becomes more powerful, he argues that the qualities that make us human—emotion, originality, behavior, and judgment—are not becoming less important, but more essential than ever. Rich Klein is the Dean of the Stuart School of Business at Illinois Institute of Technology, where he leads efforts to innovate business education and foster student success. Previously, he served as Vice Chancellor of Institutional Effectiveness and Student Success at the University of Nebraska at Omaha and held leadership and faculty positions at Florida International University and Clemson University. title: Can Machines Think? Artificial Intelligence 75 Years in the Making | Rich Klein | TEDxIllinois Tech
